{{Top|leg}}
'''Sava Matar''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived in [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Matar was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Null Racket]]'' that operated in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]].<ref name="SWG:TDHSP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Take Down Hardened Space Pirate}} on Corellia</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Reego Hinterstar]]'s [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] crew intercepted the ''Null Racket'' and robbed Captain Matar's cargo. Sava Matar then hired a freelance strike team to track down Hinterstar on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and retrieve the cargo.<ref name="SWG:TDHSP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sava Matar was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TDHSP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Captain Sava Matar was mentioned in a mission called "Take Down Hardened Space Pirate" available on [[mission terminal]]s on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:TDHSP" />
